## Overview

Compute d1 distances from each F-matrix to the empirical mean (neutral, first 250),
attach tree positional information from the corresponding `_breaks.csv` files, and
write distance tables for the new long-genome scenarios.

## Import Libraries

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(phylodyn)
```

## Paths and helpers

```{r}
data_dir <- "data2"
breaks_dir <- "../../Simulation/Slim(primary)/trees_newick"

F_mean_neutral <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "F_empirical_mean_neutrals_r400_first250.rds"))

dist_d1 <- function(F1, F2) {
  sum(abs(F1 - F2))
}

fmt <- function(x) {
  out <- format(x, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
  out <- sub("0+$", "", sub("\\.$", "", out))
  out
}

load_Fs_dir <- function(dir_path) {
  files <- sort(list.files(dir_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(NULL)
  Fs_nested <- lapply(files, readRDS)
  names(Fs_nested) <- paste0(sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(files)), ".tree")
  Fs_nested
}

distances_with_positions <- function(Fs_nested, breaks_dir, scenario_tag, show_progress = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(Fs_nested)) return(tibble())

  if (is.null(names(Fs_nested))) {
    stop("Fs_nested must be a named list (tree sequence filenames as names).")
  }

  if (show_progress) {
    pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(Fs_nested), style = 3)
    on.exit(close(pb), add = TRUE)
  }

  results <- vector("list", length(Fs_nested))
  for (i in seq_along(Fs_nested)) {
    if (show_progress) setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
    stem <- names(Fs_nested)[i]
    csv_path <- file.path(breaks_dir, paste0(sub("\\.tree$", "", stem), "_breaks.csv"))
    if (!file.exists(csv_path)) {
      warning("Missing break file: ", csv_path)
      next
    }

    df_breaks <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    df_breaks <- df_breaks[order(df_breaks$tree_index), ]

    F_list <- Fs_nested[[i]]
    n_use <- min(length(F_list), nrow(df_breaks))
    if (length(F_list) != nrow(df_breaks)) {
      warning(sprintf("Length mismatch for %s (Fs=%d, breaks=%d); truncating to %d",
                      stem, length(F_list), nrow(df_breaks), n_use))
    }

    distances <- vapply(
      F_list[seq_len(n_use)],
      function(Fmat) dist_d1(Fmat, F_mean_neutral),
      numeric(1)
    )

    results[[i]] <- tibble(
      scenario = scenario_tag,
      file = df_breaks$file[seq_len(n_use)],
      tree_index = df_breaks$tree_index[seq_len(n_use)],
      left = df_breaks$left[seq_len(n_use)],
      right = df_breaks$right[seq_len(n_use)],
      mid = df_breaks$mid[seq_len(n_use)],
      distance = distances
    )
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}

distances_with_positions_from_files <- function(files, breaks_dir, scenario_tag, show_progress = TRUE) {
  if (length(files) == 0L) return(tibble())

  if (show_progress) {
    pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(files), style = 3)
    on.exit(close(pb), add = TRUE)
  }

  results <- vector("list", length(files))
  for (i in seq_along(files)) {
    if (show_progress) setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
    f <- files[[i]]
    if (show_progress) {
      cat(sprintf("\n[%s] %d/%d %s\n", scenario_tag, i, length(files), basename(f)))
    }
    F_list <- readRDS(f)
    stem <- paste0(sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(f)), ".tree")
    csv_path <- file.path(breaks_dir, paste0(sub("\\.tree$", "", stem), "_breaks.csv"))
    if (!file.exists(csv_path)) {
      warning("Missing break file: ", csv_path)
      next
    }

    df_breaks <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    df_breaks <- df_breaks[order(df_breaks$tree_index), ]

    n_use <- min(length(F_list), nrow(df_breaks))
    if (length(F_list) != nrow(df_breaks)) {
      warning(sprintf("Length mismatch for %s (Fs=%d, breaks=%d); truncating to %d",
                      stem, length(F_list), nrow(df_breaks), n_use))
    }

    distances <- vapply(
      F_list[seq_len(n_use)],
      function(Fmat) dist_d1(Fmat, F_mean_neutral),
      numeric(1)
    )

    results[[i]] <- tibble(
      scenario = scenario_tag,
      file = df_breaks$file[seq_len(n_use)],
      tree_index = df_breaks$tree_index[seq_len(n_use)],
      left = df_breaks$left[seq_len(n_use)],
      right = df_breaks$right[seq_len(n_use)],
      mid = df_breaks$mid[seq_len(n_use)],
      distance = distances
    )
  }

  bind_rows(results)
}
```

## Compute distances for new scenarios

```{r}
out_dir <- "../dists_all_2"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# --- Neutral: last 250 simulations -----------------------------------------
neutral_fs_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "Fs_nested_neutrals_r400")
neutral_files <- sort(list.files(neutral_fs_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE))
if (length(neutral_files) == 0L) stop("Missing neutral Fs in ", neutral_fs_dir)

n_total_neutral <- length(neutral_files)
start_idx <- max(1L, n_total_neutral - 250L + 1L)
neutral_last_250_files <- neutral_files[start_idx:n_total_neutral]

neutral_tag <- "Neutral_last_250"
neutral_df <- distances_with_positions_from_files(
  neutral_last_250_files,
  breaks_dir,
  neutral_tag,
  show_progress = TRUE
)

neutral_out <- file.path(out_dir, "dist_all_new_neutral_last250.csv")
write.csv(neutral_df, neutral_out, row.names = FALSE)
message("Wrote: ", neutral_out, " (n=", nrow(neutral_df), ")")
```

```{r}
scenario_dirs <- list(
  "s=0.01F=0.25" = file.path(data_dir, "Fs_nested_selectives_r404"),
  "s=0.01F=0.5"  = file.path(data_dir, "Fs_nested_selectives_r405"),
  "s=0.01F=0.75" = file.path(data_dir, "Fs_nested_selectives_r406")
)

all_results <- list()

for (scenario_tag in names(scenario_dirs)) {
  fs_dir <- scenario_dirs[[scenario_tag]]
  fs_files <- sort(list.files(fs_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(fs_files) == 0L) {
    message("Skipping ", scenario_tag, " (missing Fs in ", fs_dir, ")")
    next
  }

  message("Processing ", scenario_tag, " ...")
  df_dist <- distances_with_positions_from_files(fs_files, breaks_dir, scenario_tag, show_progress = TRUE)
  message("Finished ", scenario_tag, " (n=", nrow(df_dist), ")")
  all_results[[scenario_tag]] <- df_dist

  out_csv <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("dist_all_new_%s.csv", scenario_tag))
  write.csv(df_dist, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  message("Wrote: ", out_csv, " (n=", nrow(df_dist), ")")
}

all_distances <- bind_rows(all_results)
write.csv(all_distances, file.path(out_dir, "dist_all_new_all_scenarios.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
